title: Orientations of two IMReps agree up to sign a.e. on the overlap of their carriers
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, and let R₁ = (M₁, θ₁, ξ₁), R₂ = (M₂, θ₂, ξ₂) be IMReps in U (Simon Ch. 6, 3.1). Then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ (Hⁿ = μHE[n]): ξ₂(x) = ξ₁(x) or ξ₂(x) = −ξ₁(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R₁ R₂ : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R₁.carrier ∩ R₂.carrier)), R₂.orient x = R₁.orient x ∨ R₂.orient x = -R₁.orient x
